visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of a wooden table featuring two colorful beverages—one a layered iced coffee with a marshmallow, the other a sparkling drink with yellow pulp—and a large croissant covered in dark powder. The background shows a modern cafe interior with warm pinkish walls and wooden furniture. (2) A wide shot reveals the cafe's minimalist interior design, featuring grey industrial walls, hanging bulb lights, and a small sign that reads 'From local to Goodness'. Empty wooden tables and chairs are neatly arranged under soft indoor lighting. (3) The focus shifts to a detailed close-up of a Tiramisu croissant topped with white cream and cocoa powder; a hand holding a pipette squeezes a dark brown coffee liqueur onto the pastry. (4) A sequence of shots shows different croissants being sliced with a knife: a pistachio cream croissant topped with candied peaches, a truffle omelet croissant with fresh greens, and a thick slice of caramelized French toast being dipped into white ice cream and strawberry jam. (5) A layered dessert in a glass parfait cup is displayed, featuring a small puff pastry on top with cream and a caramelized fruit. (6) The camera captures a close-up of a professional espresso machine with wooden handles as dark coffee is extracted into a metal cup. (7) A variety of bakery items are shown on wooden shelves inside a 'Auma' bakery section, where customers wearing face masks browse and pick out bread. (8) The final shots show the exterior of 'Auma Cafe & Brew' with its logo and a yellow A-frame sign on the sidewalk.
